newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Chinese PM Li Peng to visit Brazil in November.
newsitem.headline: Chinese PM Li Peng to visit Brazil in November.

text.p: Chinese Prime Minister Li Peng is scheduled to make an official visit to Brazil on Nov. 7-12, the Brazilian Foreign Ministry said on Thursday.

During his trip, Li Peng will meet with President Fernando Henrique Cardoso in Brasilia and visit Brazil's National Space Studies Institute in Sao Jose dos Campos which is involved in a joint Brazilian-Chinese space satellite programme.

The Chinese leader is also due to meet with Amazonas state governor Amazonino Mendes. Chinese and other Asian logging companies are currently buying large areas of the Amazon rainforest to exploit their massive timber reserves.
